kbArticles.title: Laptop Does Not Power On with AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: No response when pressing power button
No LED indicators light up
System was working previously
kbArticles.cause: SP-CHG-65W adapter failure, depleted SP-BATT-15X, or power button flex cable issue.
resolution: Connect SP-CHG-65W and attempt power on
Perform hard reset: hold power button for 30 seconds with adapter disconnected
Verify SP-CHG-65W LED is illuminated
Test with alternate SP-CHG-65W adapter
If no POST, escalate to Tier 2 for motherboard assessment

kbArticles.title: SP-CHG-65W Adapter Gets Excessively Hot
symptoms: Power adapter is too hot to touch
Adapter emits burning smell
Adapter cuts out when hot
kbArticles.cause: Overloaded SP-CHG-65W adapter or internal thermal protection fault. Faulty unit.
resolution: Immediately unplug SP-CHG-65W adapter
Do not continue using the adapter
Test with alternate SP-CHG-65W from WH-JCY-003 (Jersey City Distribution Hub - Secaucus WH) inventory
Replace SP-CHG-65W — defective adapters are safety hazards
Do not attempt to repair the adapter

kbArticles.title: Power Cuts Out Under Load on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: System shuts down immediately when running demanding applications
Power loss occurs with SP-CHG-65W connected
Event log shows unexpected shutdown
kbArticles.cause: SP-CHG-65W adapter cannot supply sufficient current under high GPU/CPU load. May also be SP-BATT-15X instability.
resolution: Verify SP-CHG-65W is genuine 65W adapter (check label)
Test with load-bearing applications while monitoring power draw
Update EC firmware for power management
Check event log for thermal vs power event
Replace SP-CHG-65W if power delivery is confirmed insufficient

kbArticles.title: USB-C Port Not Charging Laptop on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: SP-CHG-65W connected to USB-C but no charging
USB-C port works for data but not power
Other USB-C ports charge fine
kbArticles.cause: One of the USB-C ports may not support Power Delivery. Or port-specific failure on motherboard.
resolution: Confirm which USB-C ports support Power Delivery (check product spec sheet)
Try alternate USB-C port on device
Inspect USB-C port for debris or bent pins
If PD-capable port is non-functional, SP-MB-15X replacement may be required
Escalate to Tier 2 for port-level diagnosis

kbArticles.title: Power Adapter Cable Damage on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: SP-CHG-65W cable is visibly frayed or kinked
Charging intermittent depending on cable position
Sparks observed near cable bend
kbArticles.cause: Physical cable damage to SP-CHG-65W power adapter. Safety hazard.
resolution: Immediately stop using the damaged SP-CHG-65W adapter
This is a safety issue — do not attempt to tape or repair the cable
Replace SP-CHG-65W from WH-JCY-003 (Jersey City Distribution Hub - Secaucus WH)
Check if within warranty — adapters covered under standard warranty
Ship replacement adapter to customer

kbArticles.title: Laptop Runs on AC But Battery Doesn't Charge on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: System works fine on AC but battery percentage stays flat
'Plugged in, not charging' status
Battery percentage was 45% when plugged in, remains 45% after hours
kbArticles.cause: Battery charge threshold set in BIOS, or SP-BATT-15X battery controller fault.
resolution: Check BIOS for battery charge limit or care mode settings
Disable charge limit and save BIOS settings
If no BIOS limit, run battery diagnostics
Update BIOS firmware
Replace SP-BATT-15X if charge circuit fault confirmed

kbArticles.title: Power Surge Damage to AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Device stopped working after power outage or surge
SP-CHG-65W adapter non-functional
Device powers on but screen remains black
kbArticles.cause: Power surge damage to SP-CHG-65W adapter or SP-MB-15X motherboard power regulation circuits.
resolution: Test with known-good SP-CHG-65W adapter
Assess motherboard power input circuits
Power surge damage not covered under standard warranty
Recommend customer use surge protector going forward
If SP-MB-15X damaged, provide out-of-warranty motherboard replacement quote
Order SP-CHG-65W from WH-JCY-003 (Jersey City Distribution Hub - Secaucus WH) first to eliminate adapter as cause

kbArticles.title: Slow Charging Speed on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: Battery charges at less than 1% per minute
Charging takes 6+ hours for full charge
Charging was faster previously
kbArticles.cause: Reduced charging speed due to thermal throttling of charge rate, battery wear, or SP-CHG-65W delivering less than rated 65W.
resolution: Confirm SP-CHG-65W is rated 65W (check label and adapter ID in BIOS)
Charge in a cool environment to prevent thermal-limited charging
Check battery wear — older batteries charge slower
Test with alternate SP-CHG-65W adapter
Update BIOS for power management improvements

kbArticles.title: No POST After Connecting New SP-CHG-65W Adapter
symptoms: System does not boot after adapter replacement
Power LED flashes but no display
New SP-CHG-65W verified working on another device
kbArticles.cause: BIOS EC may not recognize new adapter after certain firmware conditions. May require BIOS reset.
resolution: Remove SP-CHG-65W and SP-BATT-15X, hold power 30 seconds
Reconnect adapter and boot — should clear EC state
If still no POST, connect to external display to check for display-only issue
Update BIOS if system posts on external display
If system does not post at all, escalate to Tier 2 for SP-MB-15X assessment

kbArticles.title: Power LED Blinking Pattern on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Power LED blinks in specific pattern instead of solid
System does not boot
LED pattern: 3 blinks, pause, 2 blinks
kbArticles.cause: POST diagnostic LED code indicating specific hardware failure. Blink pattern maps to component fault.
resolution: Document exact blink pattern
Refer to POST blink code table: 3-2 pattern indicates RAM fault
Reseat SP-RAM-16-DDR5 module(s)
Test with single RAM module
Replace SP-RAM-16-DDR5 if fault persists
Escalate to Tier 2 if blink pattern indicates motherboard fault

kbArticles.title: Device Powers Off When Closing Lid on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: System shuts down instead of sleeping when lid closed
Data loss occurs when lid is closed
Power button and lid have same behavior
kbArticles.cause: OS power settings configured to shut down (instead of sleep) on lid close.
resolution: Access OS power plan settings
Change 'When I close the lid' to 'Sleep' or 'Hibernate'
Verify setting for both battery and plugged-in scenarios
Save settings and test by closing lid
If system still shuts down despite correct setting, check BIOS lid-close action

kbArticles.title: Wake from Sleep Fails on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: Pressing power button or key does not wake device from sleep
Display stays black after wake attempt
Power LED indicates sleep state but no response
kbArticles.cause: Deep sleep state (S3/Modern Standby) issue or display driver failure on wake.
resolution: Hold power button for 10 seconds to force shutdown, then restart
Update BIOS and display driver
Change sleep state from Modern Standby to S3 in BIOS if available
Disable Fast Startup in OS power settings
If wake failure persists, escalate — may indicate SP-MB-15X EC firmware issue

kbArticles.title: Power Button Stuck on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: Power button physically depressed and stuck
System continuously powers on and off
Button click not tactile
kbArticles.cause: Debris lodged under power button or damaged power button assembly on SP-MB-15X motherboard.
resolution: Attempt to clear debris with compressed air
If button is mechanically stuck, do not force — internal damage risk
Power button assembly replacement requires SP-MB-15X service
Escalate to Tier 2 for power button repair
Order SP-MB-15X from WH-SJO-002 if full motherboard replacement required

kbArticles.title: Third-Party Charger Warning on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Warning: 'Unrecognized charger connected'
Charging works but at reduced speed
System recommends using genuine adapter
kbArticles.cause: Third-party USB-C charger lacks the ID chip required by AeroVolt firmware for full power delivery handshake.
resolution: Advise customer to use SP-CHG-65W genuine adapter for full performance
Explain risks: third-party adapters may not provide stable 65W and can cause charging issues
Replace with SP-CHG-65W from WH-JCY-003 (Jersey City Distribution Hub - Secaucus WH)
If customer insists on third-party, document and note warranty implications

kbArticles.title: Docking Station Not Powering Laptop on AeroVolt Nexus Docking Station
symptoms: Laptop connected to dock via USB-C but battery not charging
Dock indicators show power but laptop shows no charge
Dock power delivery LED flashing
kbArticles.cause: AeroVolt Nexus Docking Station not receiving adequate power from SP-CHG-65W, or dock firmware power negotiation failure.
resolution: Ensure SP-CHG-65W is connected to dock and illuminated
Try different USB-C port on dock
Update dock firmware to latest version
Inspect dock USB-C connector for damage
Replace dock if power passthrough consistently fails

kbArticles.title: System Runs Only When Plugged In — Battery Bypassed on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: System shuts down immediately when SP-CHG-65W is unplugged
Battery shows 0% and won't charge
System works fine when plugged in
kbArticles.cause: Completely discharged and dead SP-BATT-15X that cannot hold any charge.
resolution: Run battery diagnostics via BIOS
Confirm battery is detected but capacity reads 0 or near-0
Replace SP-BATT-15X
After replacement, perform battery calibration cycle
Order SP-BATT-15X from WH-SJO-002 (San Jose Spare Parts & Warranty Depot) for fastest delivery

kbArticles.title: EC Firmware Update Causes Power Issues on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Power management issues after recent firmware update
Charging stops after EC firmware update
System power unstable post-update
kbArticles.cause: Incomplete or failed EC firmware update causing power management regression.
resolution: Download and re-apply the latest BIOS/EC firmware from support portal
Ensure SP-CHG-65W is connected during update
Do not interrupt firmware update process
If EC is stuck in failed state, contact Tier 2 for EC recovery procedure
In rare cases, SP-MB-15X replacement may be needed after botched EC update

kbArticles.title: AC Adapter LED Not Illuminated on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: SP-CHG-65W adapter LED does not light up when plugged in
Laptop does not detect power from adapter
Adapter feels warm but no LED
kbArticles.cause: Faulty LED circuit in SP-CHG-65W or adapter in protection mode due to fault condition.
resolution: Try adapter on another outlet to rule out power source issue
Test SP-CHG-65W on another AeroVolt laptop if available
No LED with no charging = replace SP-CHG-65W
Order from WH-JCY-003 (Jersey City Distribution Hub - Secaucus WH)

kbArticles.title: Power Management Settings Reset After Update on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: Power plan reverted to balanced after OS update
Battery charge limit reset to default
Custom power settings lost
kbArticles.cause: OS or BIOS update overwrote custom power management settings and battery care configuration.
resolution: Re-configure power plan in OS settings
Re-enter battery charge limit in BIOS
Document custom settings for future reference
Check if power management software needs reinstall after OS update

kbArticles.title: Short Circuit Indicator Triggered on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: SP-CHG-65W shuts off immediately when plugged into laptop
Adapter cycles on and off rapidly
System does not power on
kbArticles.cause: Short circuit in laptop power input circuitry, damaged USB-C port, or SP-MB-15X power rail fault.
resolution: DO NOT continue to plug in adapter — risk of damage
Test SP-CHG-65W on another device to confirm adapter is functioning
Inspect USB-C power port for debris or damage
This indicates SP-MB-15X power circuit failure — escalate to Tier 2 immediately
Ship device for service if motherboard fault confirmed

kbArticles.title: SP-CHG-65W Compatibility with AeroVolt Nexus Docking Station
symptoms: Customer asks if SP-CHG-65W works with docking station
Docking station has different wattage adapter bundled
Adapter interchangeability inquiry
kbArticles.cause: Customer inquiry — no fault. SP-CHG-65W compatibility check with AeroVolt Nexus Docking Station.
resolution: Confirm SP-CHG-65W (65W) is compatible with AeroVolt Nexus Docking Station
Note: dock may require 65W minimum to power downstream devices and charge laptop simultaneously
If customer is running multiple monitors and charging through dock, recommend verifying power budget
SP-CHG-65W available from WH-JCY-003 (Jersey City Distribution Hub - Secaucus WH) and WH-JCY-003

kbArticles.title: Power LED Always On — Cannot Power Off on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Power LED stays on even after shutdown
Cannot confirm device is fully powered off
Device appears in off state but LED glows
kbArticles.cause: Network wake or USB wake feature keeping LED active. Some states indicate standby rather than full shutdown.
resolution: Check BIOS for 'Wake on LAN', 'Wake on USB', 'Deep Sleep' settings
Enable Deep Sleep / S5 state in BIOS
Disable network wake features
Verify OS is performing full shutdown vs hybrid shutdown (disable Fast Startup)
If LED stays on even after S5 is enabled, escalate — possible SP-MB-15X EC fault

kbArticles.title: Multiple Devices on Same SP-CHG-65W Adapter — Compatibility
symptoms: Customer wants to use one SP-CHG-65W adapter for multiple AeroVolt laptops
Adapter compatibility across models inquiry
kbArticles.cause: Customer inquiry regarding SP-CHG-65W cross-model compatibility.
resolution: Confirm SP-CHG-65W is compatible across AV-LP-15X-PRO, AV-LP-13A-STRAT, AV-LP-A5X-PRO
Note: QA-LP-17G-APEX may have higher wattage requirements — verify specifications
One adapter per device is recommended for charging speed
Sharing adapters between devices is functionally acceptable but not recommended for simultaneous use

kbArticles.title: Charging Not Starting After Long Storage on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Device stored for 6+ months will not charge
Battery at 0% and SP-CHG-65W shows adapter detected but no charge progress
System does not power on
kbArticles.cause: SP-BATT-15X battery deeply discharged below recovery threshold during long storage.
resolution: Leave SP-CHG-65W connected for 30-60 minutes with device off
Battery recovery mode should begin automatically at very low charge rate
After 30 min, attempt power on
If battery does not recover, replace SP-BATT-15X
Advise customer to store at 50% charge and charge every 3 months

kbArticles.title: Charging Via USB-C on Left vs Right Port on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Charging only works on one USB-C port
Right USB-C port shows 'not charging'
Customer asking which port supports charging
kbArticles.cause: On AV-LP-15X-PRO, only the left USB-C port supports full Power Delivery (65W). Right port is data-only.
resolution: Advise customer to connect SP-CHG-65W to left-side USB-C port
Right USB-C port is for data/video only — does not support charging
If left port is damaged, escalate for SP-MB-15X assessment
Document this as informational — no hardware fault

kbArticles.title: CPU Fan Not Spinning on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: No audible fan noise under heavy load
System overheats and throttles rapidly
Fan diagnostics report fan failure
kbArticles.cause: Failed SP-FAN-15X cooling fan assembly. Fan motor seized or fan connector disconnected.
resolution: Run fan diagnostics from BIOS
Listen for fan spin-up during POST
Inspect fan connector on motherboard
Replace SP-FAN-15X if fan does not spin in diagnostics
Order SP-FAN-15X from WH-FRA-004 (Frankfurt Logistics Center - Hall 4)

kbArticles.title: Loud Fan Noise on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Fan runs constantly at maximum speed
Loud grinding or rattling noise from fan
Fan noise increases when system wakes from sleep
kbArticles.cause: Debris in SP-FAN-15X fan blades, worn fan bearing, or thermal management firmware issue.
resolution: Clean vents with compressed air to remove dust buildup
Run fan diagnostics to check for bearing noise pattern
Update BIOS for fan curve improvements
If grinding/rattling noise persists, replace SP-FAN-15X
Source from WH-FRA-004 (Frankfurt Logistics Center - Hall 4)

kbArticles.title: System Overheating and Throttling on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: CPU performance drops drastically after a few minutes of use
System temperature exceeds 95°C under load
Fan is spinning but throttling occurs
kbArticles.cause: Degraded thermal paste on SP-HEAT-15X heat sink, partially blocked vents, or worn SP-FAN-15X.
resolution: Clean cooling vents with compressed air
Replenish thermal paste on CPU and GPU heatsink (SP-HEAT-15X)
Test fan RPM in BIOS diagnostics
Ensure device is not used on fabric surfaces
Replace SP-HEAT-15X if thermal interface material is dried out or heat pipes are damaged

kbArticles.title: Fan Speed Control Not Working on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: Fan always at 100% speed regardless of temperature
Fan speed cannot be adjusted via software
Fan curve appears non-responsive
kbArticles.cause: EC firmware bug causing fan control to default to maximum speed mode. SP-FAN-15X hardware likely working.
resolution: Update BIOS/EC firmware from support portal
After firmware update, test fan behavior under various loads
If fan still stuck at max, run fan diagnostics
Check fan PWM signal with service tool if available
Replace SP-FAN-15X only if hardware fan control circuit confirmed faulty

kbArticles.title: Heat Sink Replacement Procedure on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Approved SP-HEAT-15X replacement
Thermal paste reapplication needed
Persistent thermal throttling after fan replacement
kbArticles.cause: Degraded thermal interface material or damaged heat pipes in SP-HEAT-15X assembly.
resolution: Power off and disconnect SP-CHG-65W and SP-BATT-15X
Remove base panel and fan assembly SP-FAN-15X
Remove SP-HEAT-15X heat sink screws in X-pattern
Clean old thermal paste from CPU/GPU with isopropyl alcohol
Apply new thermal paste in pea-sized dot method
Install new SP-HEAT-15X and secure screws in X-pattern to spec torque
Reinstall SP-FAN-15X and test for throttling

kbArticles.title: Thermal Shutdown During Video Encoding on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: System shuts down after 10-15 minutes of video encoding
Event log shows thermal protection triggered
No warning before shutdown
kbArticles.cause: Sustained high CPU load exceeds cooling capacity of SP-FAN-15X or SP-HEAT-15X has degraded thermal contact.
resolution: Clean fan vents with compressed air
Test on hard flat surface for proper airflow
Update BIOS for improved thermal management
Monitor CPU temperature during encoding with diagnostic tool
If temperatures above 90°C, replace SP-HEAT-15X and reapply thermal paste

kbArticles.title: Fan Replacement Procedure on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: SP-FAN-15X ordered and ready for replacement
Technician-initiated fan assembly replacement
kbArticles.cause: Scheduled or approved SP-FAN-15X cooling fan assembly replacement.
resolution: Power off and disconnect all power sources
Remove base panel
Disconnect SP-FAN-15X connector from motherboard
Remove fan mounting screws
Extract SP-FAN-15X from chassis
Install new SP-FAN-15X and reconnect power connector
Reapply thermal paste if SP-HEAT-15X was disturbed
Test fan operation in BIOS before closing chassis

kbArticles.title: Dust Accumulation Causing Thermal Issues on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: Gradual increase in fan noise over several months
System temperatures higher than baseline
Vents visibly dusty
kbArticles.cause: Dust buildup blocking SP-FAN-15X and SP-HEAT-15X air channels, reducing cooling efficiency.
resolution: Power off and unplug SP-CHG-65W
Use compressed air to blow out vents from exhaust end
For thorough cleaning, open base panel and clean SP-FAN-15X blades and fins directly
Clean SP-HEAT-15X fin stack
Reassemble and verify temperatures return to normal range
Recommend annual cleaning to customer

kbArticles.title: Single Fan vs Dual Fan Thermal Performance on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: Customer reports thermal issues after partial fan replacement
One fan replaced, one not — temperatures still high
Technician question on fan replacement strategy
kbArticles.cause: QA-LP-17G-APEX uses dual SP-FAN-15X fan assemblies (CPU + GPU). Replacing only one may not resolve thermal issues.
resolution: Confirm both SP-FAN-15X fans are operational in BIOS diagnostics
If one fan is degraded, recommend replacing both simultaneously to ensure balanced cooling
Order two SP-FAN-15X units from WH-FRA-004 (Frankfurt Logistics Center - Hall 4)
Both fans share the SP-HEAT-15X heat pipe network — inspect heat pipes for damage

kbArticles.title: Abnormal CPU Temperature on Idle on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: CPU temperature at 70°C while idle
Fan runs loudly even with no applications open
System warm to touch when idle
kbArticles.cause: Background processes consuming high CPU (e.g., antivirus, update services) causing false 'idle' temperature. May also indicate SP-HEAT-15X degradation.
resolution: Open Task Manager and identify high CPU usage processes
End or configure background processes
Test true idle temperature with no applications running
If temperature still above 60°C at true idle, inspect SP-HEAT-15X thermal contact
Reapply thermal paste if heat sink is dry

kbArticles.title: Heat Pipes Damaged on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Visible dent or crack on heat pipe visible through vents
Thermal throttling despite clean vents and good thermal paste
One side of SP-HEAT-15X fin stack barely warm while CPU is hot
kbArticles.cause: Physical damage to copper heat pipes in SP-HEAT-15X assembly, causing coolant leak and reduced heat transfer.
resolution: Heat pipe damage requires full SP-HEAT-15X assembly replacement
Document damage — usually caused by drop or physical pressure
Assess warranty coverage
Order SP-HEAT-15X from WH-FRA-004 (Frankfurt Logistics Center - Hall 4)
Replace SP-HEAT-15X and reapply thermal paste on all contact surfaces

kbArticles.title: Fan Speed Reporting Incorrect in OS on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Third-party monitoring tool shows fan at 0 RPM
Fan is audibly spinning
OS power management shows no fan data
kbArticles.cause: Third-party tools may not support proprietary EC fan reporting on AeroVolt platforms. Not a SP-FAN-15X hardware issue.
resolution: Use AeroVolt System Diagnostics utility for accurate fan RPM readings
Run BIOS fan diagnostics to confirm fan is operational
Advise customer that third-party tools may not report EC-managed fan data accurately
No hardware action needed if fan is operating correctly per BIOS

kbArticles.title: Thermal Paste Reapplication Service for AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Device is 2+ years old with increasing temperatures
Customer requests preventive thermal maintenance
Performance degradation due to thermal throttling
kbArticles.cause: Thermal paste on SP-HEAT-15X has dried and hardened over time, reducing heat transfer efficiency.
resolution: Schedule technician service for thermal paste reapplication
Technician to disassemble and clean CPU/GPU surfaces
Apply new high-quality thermal compound to SP-HEAT-15X contact surfaces
Clean SP-FAN-15X and SP-HEAT-15X fin stack during same service
Verify temperatures post-service via BIOS diagnostics

kbArticles.title: Fan Starts Then Stops During Boot on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: Fan spins briefly at startup then stops completely
Fan does not restart even under CPU load
System overheats within minutes
kbArticles.cause: EC fan control reading incorrect sensor data, causing fan to shut down. May be SP-FAN-15X motor issue or EC firmware bug.
resolution: Update BIOS/EC firmware to resolve known fan control bugs
Run fan diagnostics — manually command fan to max speed
If fan spins on manual command but not automatically, EC firmware issue
If fan does not spin on manual command, replace SP-FAN-15X
